description: This file defines the DefaultTypeManifestProvider class, which configures a set of well-known types and allowed types for serialization in the Orleans framework. It includes methods for post-configuration and inner configuration, setting up type IDs and type references.

classes.name: DefaultTypeManifestProvider
classes.description: A class that provides default type manifest configuration for Orleans serialization, including well-known types and allowed types.

methods.name: PostConfigure
methods.description: Cleans up the options bookkeeping by clearing the TypeManifestProviders collection.

methods.name: ConfigureInner
methods.description: Sets up the well-known type IDs with their corresponding types and adds specific allowed types for serialization.
